stages.blurb: Set up for a clean run. Never use cheats on your trophy save: they switch off trophies and saving. Make a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission, because there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. And do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends: it is the one spot that disappears, and it is the only missable trophy in the game.
stages.title: Before you start

stages.blurb: Chapters 1 to 4, the final mission, the named story missions and the stranger strands. These trophies unlock as you play, so enjoy the campaign at your own pace and take the stranger missions as you meet them. Once Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is done you can switch characters and call your partner, which opens the partner trophies.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.blurb: The long middle: stunts, the shooting ranges, drone races, car races, fishing, arcade games, challenges, meditation spots, collectible cards, WAiNK scans and discovering vehicles. Do these as you travel between missions so the cleanup is short. Keep the meditation spots in mind from Chapter 1 onward.
stages.title: Activities and collectibles

stages.blurb: Robberies, heists and the money trophies: bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, illegal operations, the jet at VCIA, the Rhino tank, and spending and laundering your cash. Garages and vehicle registrations live here too. Bank vaults always bring 4 stars, so they pair well with Hot Together.
stages.title: Crime and money

stages.blurb: The story is done and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks. Work it top to bottom: 15 of the 18 card sets, 70 of the 80 challenges, and the rest. When the checklist hits 100%, A Long Road pops, and the platinum follows as soon as the last straggler is cleaned up.
stages.title: After the credits
